items.markdown:
**Archify** is `an open-source AI agent skill that converts codebases or natural language descriptions into interactive, self-contained architecture and system diagrams`.[[1]](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify)[[2]](https://www.coddykit.com/pages/blog-detail?id=513029&slug=archify-the-open-source-ai-agent-skill-with-20-000-github-stars-that-turns-code-)

### Key Features

- **AI Coding Assistant Integration:** Works as a plugin or skill for tools like Cursor, Claude Code , Codex CLI, and OpenCode.[[1]](https://www.coddykit.com/pages/blog-detail?id=513029&slug=archify-the-open-source-ai-agent-skill-with-20-000-github-stars-that-turns-code-)
- **Five Diagram Modes:** Supports architecture (components and services), workflow (processes and CI/CD), sequence (API call chains), data flow (pipelines and lineage), and lifecycle (states and retries).[[1]](https://taku.ai/blog/skill-archify)
- **Atomic Validation:** Compiles system descriptions into typed JSON and validates schema, layout, routes, and label clearances before outputting HTML.[[1]](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify)[[2]](https://www.coddykit.com/pages/blog-detail?id=513029&slug=archify-the-open-source-ai-agent-skill-with-20-000-github-stars-that-turns-code-)
- **Interactive HTML Output:** Produces a standalone HTML file where you can click components, trace routes, switch themes (dark/light), and export share cards or images (PNG, SVG, WebM).[[1]](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify)[[2]](https://www.coddykit.com/pages/blog-detail?id=513029&slug=archify-the-open-source-ai-agent-skill-with-20-000-github-stars-that-turns-code-)
- **Architecture Delta:** Compares before-and-after snapshots to generate a report on added, removed, or changed components during PR reviews.[[1]](https://www.coddykit.com/pages/blog-detail?id=513029&slug=archify-the-open-source-ai-agent-skill-with-20-000-github-stars-that-turns-code-)

### How to Install & Use

- **Global Install:** You can install it via package managers using `npx skills add tt-a1i/archify -g` or `npm install -g @archify/skills`.
- **Manual Setup:** Download the skill folder and place it into your project or global Claude skills directory (`~/.claude/skills/`).
- **CLI Usage:** Run direct commands such as `node archify/bin/archify.mjs guide "your description"`.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HMZXCg37YGU&t=33)[[2]](https://www.coddykit.com/pages/blog-detail?id=513044&slug=archify-the-open-source-agent-skill-with-36-000-github-stars-that-turns-code-int)[[3]](https://www.getclaudeskills.com/skills/archify-tt-a1i)[[4]](https://www.coddykit.com/pages/blog-detail?id=513029&slug=archify-the-open-source-ai-agent-skill-with-20-000-github-stars-that-turns-code-)
